The Intra-agency news article slice appears light blue, while Interview (8.8%) is dark blue/navy.
The Interview slice is dark blue/navy, not dark green. Dark green is used for External News Article.

"Stimulus Type" is the chart's center label, not a slice. The 1.1% slice is labeled "Social Media Post", which is missing from the description.
